item.title: Cache Tech Community Meetup - July 2026
item.description: Join us on Saturday, July 25th, 2026 for a special Cache Tech Community meetup featuring CodeCamp: Bridgerland participants presenting their incredible projects! Everyone who participated has the chance to share what they built. Come celebrate their achievements and connect with Cache Valley’s amazing tech community. Open to everyone—whether you participated in CodeCamp or just want to see some awesome projects!
